findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tracked_slips, doctor_conversation, tail_read, open_doctor_conversation, list_doctor_conversations, get_doctor_conversation, get_tail_feed, get_tail_post, show_saved_grade, show_doctor_conversation, show_tail_feed, show_tail_post, show_saved_slip · Private data: get_history_summary, tail_read, remember_doctor_note, get_tail_feed, show_tail_feed, show_history_records, prepare_sportsbook_handoff · Public sink: get_saved_reports, doctor_conversation, tail_read, tail_post, get_tail_feed, get_tail_post, preview_tail_post, publish_tail_post, show_tail_feed, show_tail_post, preview_tail_slip · Destructive: doctor_conversation, get_doctor_quota, forget_doctor_note, revise_tracked_slip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tracked_slips, doctor_conversation, tail_read, open_doctor_conversation, list_doctor_conversations, get_doctor_conversation, get_tail_feed, get_tail_post, show_saved_grade, show_doctor_conversation, show_tail_feed, show_tail_post, show_saved_slip · Private data: get_history_summary, tail_read, remember_doctor_note, get_tail_feed, show_tail_feed, show_history_records, prepare_sportsbook_handoff · Public sink: get_saved_reports, doctor_conversation, tail_read, tail_post, get_tail_feed, get_tail_post, preview_tail_post, publish_tail_post, show_tail_feed, show_tail_post, preview_tail_slip · Destructive: doctor_conversation, get_doctor_quota, forget_doctor_note, revise_tracked_slip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "prepare_sportsbook_handoff" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
